description: Full body chibi anime pixel art game sprite, 6-year-old little boy facing the viewer, standing straight, arms relaxed at sides, empty hands. Messy chestnut-brown hair with a few spiky bangs, big warm amber eyes, cheerful face. Simple village kid clothes: off-white linen tunic, small brown leather vest, dark green scarf, belt, dark brown shorts, brown leather boots.
style_usage: Copy ONLY the drawing style and the small-child chibi body proportions (very big head, short body), black pixel outline, shading and detail level. Do NOT copy the colors, hair or clothing.
